title: Close PR #455 compatibility and custody re-review gaps
description: Address the four P1 findings from the external re-review of PR #455 at f7ebe7a: enforce canonical attunement boundaries during legacy adoption, expose held legacy ids and bounded GM-review markers in model context, distinguish dropped claimable custody from sold/lost rows, and make Orb of Dragonkind's pending conditional unattunement semantics fail closed before bond creation rather than creating an unconditional lock. Add cross-boundary regression tests and perform a holistic adjacent-code review.
notes: Implemented PR #455 re-review fixes. Centralized the canonical attunement contract so adoption and normal attune share requiresAttunement, variant, and pending-curse gates; Orb conditional blocksUnattune now fails closed before bond creation while nonvoluntary cleanup remains operable. Held inventory context always exposes exact ids and a bounded durable adoption-review marker/reason. Migration 0017 persists explicit dropped/sold/lost unheld disposition; only co-located dropped rows are rendered, listed, claimable, destructible, or eligible for give-item guidance. Audited every inventory INSERT/UPDATE and added the direct nonmagical-ammunition producer. Root cause of prior misses: fixes were reviewed at the reported functions and schema-family tests, but lifecycle invariants were not traced across all producers, persistence states, and downstream consumers; duplicated attunement validation and the false unheld=claimable assumption escaped. Verification: npm run verify:worktree passes 260 files / 4,629 tests with 19 documented skips; focused cross-boundary suite passes 268 tests.
close_reason: All four PR #455 compatibility/custody P1 findings fixed with cross-boundary regression coverage and full worktree verification.
